source.text: שִׁ֥יר מִזְמ֗וֹר לִבְנֵ֫י קֹ֥רַח לַמְנַצֵּ֣חַ עַל־מָחֲלַ֣ת לְעַנּ֑וֹת מַ֝שְׂכִּ֗יל לְהֵימָ֥ן הָאֶזְרָחִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: A song, a psalm of [the] sons of Korah, for the director, on mahalath leannoth, a maskil of Heman the Ezrahite.

en.L: A song; a psalm of the sons of Korah. For the director: on mahalath leannoth. A maskil of Heman the Ezrahite.
en.B: A song. A psalm of the sons of Korah. For the music director. On mahalath leannoth. A maskil of Heman the Ezrahite.
en.R: A song with music, from the family of Korah. For the leader of the music. To a tune for times of suffering. A song to teach, by Heman the Ezrahite.

fr.L: Un cantique ; un psaume des fils de Coré. Au chef de chœur : sur mahalath leannoth. Un maskil d’Hémân l’Ezrahite.
fr.B: Un cantique. Un psaume des fils de Coré. Au chef de chœur. Sur mahalath leannoth. Un maskil d’Hémân l’Ezrahite.
fr.R: Un chant avec de la musique, de la famille de Coré. Pour le chef des musiciens. Sur un air pour les temps de souffrance. Un chant pour enseigner, d’Hémân l’Ezrahite.

sw.L: Wimbo; zaburi ya wana wa Kora. Kwa kiongozi wa kwaya: juu ya mahalathi leanothi. Maskili ya Hemani Mwezrahi.
sw.B: Wimbo. Zaburi ya wana wa Kora. Kwa kiongozi wa kwaya. Kwa mahalathi leanothi. Maskili ya Hemani Mwezrahi.
sw.R: Wimbo wa kuimbwa na vinanda, wa ukoo wa Kora. Kwa kiongozi wa waimbaji. Kwa mtindo wa wimbo wa nyakati za mateso. Wimbo wa kufundisha, wa Hemani Mwezrahi.

es.L: Cántico; salmo de los hijos de Coré. Al director del coro: sobre mahalat leanot. Masquil de Hemán el ezraíta.
es.B: Cántico. Salmo de los hijos de Coré. Al director del coro. Sobre mahalat leanot. Masquil de Hemán el ezraíta.
es.R: Un canto con música, de la familia de Coré. Para el director de la música. Con una melodía para tiempos de sufrimiento. Un canto para enseñar, de Hemán el ezraíta.

vi.L: [Một] bài ca; [một] thi thiên của con cháu Cô-ra. Cho người chỉ huy [ban nhạc]: theo ma-ha-lát lê-a-nốt. [Một] bài Mát-kin của Hê-man người Ếch-ra-hít.
vi.B: Bài ca. Thi thiên của con cháu Cô-ra. Cho nhạc trưởng. Theo ma-ha-lát lê-a-nốt. Bài Mát-kin của Hê-man người Ếch-ra-hít.
vi.R: Một bài ca có nhạc đệm, của gia đình Cô-ra. Cho người hướng dẫn ban nhạc. Theo điệu dành cho lúc khổ đau. Bài ca để dạy dỗ, của Hê-man người Ếch-ra-hít.

ko.L: 노래, 고라 자손의 시. 지휘자를 위하여. 마할랏 르안놋에 맞추어. 에스라 사람 헤만의 마스길.
ko.B: 노래. 고라 자손의 시. 음악 지휘자를 위하여. 마할랏 르안놋에 맞추어. 에스라 사람 헤만의 마스길.
ko.R: 고라 집안 사람들이 지은, 음악에 맞춘 노래. 찬양 인도자를 위해 고난의 때에 부르는 곡조에 맞추어. 에스라 사람 헤만이 지은, 가르침과 깨달음을 주는 노래.

pt.L: Cântico; salmo dos filhos de Corá. Para o regente: sobre maalate leanote. Masquil de Hemã, o ezraíta.
pt.B: Cântico. Salmo dos filhos de Corá. Para o mestre de música. Sobre maalate leanote. Masquil de Hemã, o ezraíta.
pt.R: Uma canção com música, da família de Corá. Para quem dirige a música. Numa melodia para tempos de sofrimento. Uma canção para ensinar, de Hemã, o ezraíta.

am.L: ቅኔ፤ የቆሬ ልጆች መዝሙር። ለመዘምራን አለቃ፤ በማሐላት ልዓኖት። የኢዝራሐዊው የሄማን ማስኪል።
am.B: መዝሙር። የቆሬ ልጆች መዝሙር። ለመዘምራን አለቃ። በማሐላት ልዓኖት። የኢዝራሐዊው የሄማን ማስኪል።
am.R: የቆሬ ልጆች በዜማ የሚዘመር መዝሙር። ለመዘምራን አለቃ። በመከራ ጊዜ በሚዘመር ዜማ። ለማስተማር ኢዝራሐዊው ሄማን ያዘጋጀው መዝሙር።

hi.L: गीत; कोरह के पुत्रों का भजन। संगीत-निर्देशक के लिए: महलत लअन्नोत पर। एज्रेही हेमान का मस्कील।
hi.B: गीत। कोरह के पुत्रों का भजन। संगीत-निर्देशक के लिए। महलत लअन्नोत पर। एज्रेही हेमान का मस्कील।
hi.R: संगीत के साथ गाने का गीत, कोरह के परिवार का। गायक-मंडली के अगुवे के लिए। दुख के समय की धुन पर। एज्रेही हेमान का एक गीत, जो शिक्षा और समझ देने के लिए है।

ru.L: Песнь; псалом сыновей Корея. Руководителю хора: на махалат леаннот. Маскиль Емана езрахитянина.
ru.B: Песнь. Псалом сыновей Корея. Руководителю хора. На махалат леаннот. Маскиль Емана езрахитянина.
ru.R: Песня с музыкой, из семьи Корея. Для руководителя музыкантов. На мотив для времени страданий. Песня Емана езрахитянина, чтобы учить.

ja.L: 歌。コラの子らの賛歌。指揮する者のために。マハラト・レアノトに合わせて。エズラ人ヘマンのマスキル。
ja.B: 歌。コラの子孫の賛歌。音楽を導く者のために。マハラト・レアノトに合わせて。エズラ人ヘマンのマスキル。
ja.R: コラの一族による、音楽に合わせた歌。音楽を導く人のために。苦しみのときの調べに合わせる。エズラ人ヘマンによる、教えるための歌。

decisions.choice: The title is verse 1
decisions.reason: The title is part of the Hebrew text and is counted as verse 1, so the verse numbers here are one higher than in Bibles that print the title without a number.

decisions.choice: the sons of Korah: a family of Levite singers
decisions.reason: The descendants of Korah, a Levite (Numbers 26:11), served as gatekeepers and singers at the temple (1 Chronicles 9:19; 2 Chronicles 20:19). Eleven psalms carry their name (42-49, 84-85, 87-88). "Of" may mean the psalm belongs to their collection or was written by one of them.

decisions.choice: the director: the one who leads the music
decisions.reason: As in 4:1, probably the leader of the temple music.

decisions.choice: mahalath leannoth: probably a tune or manner of singing
decisions.reason: Mahalath (also in the title of 53:1) may come from the word for sickness; leannoth may mean "to afflict" or "to sing". The words may name a tune or say how the psalm was sung. Their exact sense is no longer known.

decisions.choice: maskil: a song of insight, or a skillful song
decisions.reason: The word comes from the verb "to have insight, act wisely". As a heading for thirteen psalms it may mark a song that teaches, or one composed with skill; its exact sense is no longer known.

decisions.choice: Heman the Ezrahite
decisions.reason: Heman was a famous wise man (1 Kings 5) and is listed among the sons of Zerah of Judah (1 Chronicles 2:6); "Ezrahite" probably means of the family of Zerah. A Heman was also one of David's chief singers (1 Chronicles 15:19). The title names both the sons of Korah and Heman, perhaps two notes about the psalm's origin.

decisions.choice: to a tune for times of suffering; a song to teach
decisions.reason: Readable gives the likeliest sense of the terms (m4, m5).

decisions.choice: "mahalath leannoth" and "maskil" kept as names at Literal and Balanced; Readable explains them as the English Readable does
decisions.reason: Their sense is uncertain (meaning decisions), so the levels that keep the Hebrew's words keep the names, as the terms note sets for Psalm titles.

decisions.choice: "mahalathi leanothi" and "maskili" kept as names at Literal and Balanced; explained at Readable as "wimbo wa nyakati za mateso" and "wimbo wa kufundisha"
alternatives: translate both words at every level
decisions.reason: The sense of both terms is no longer certain: mahalath leannoth is probably a tune or way of singing, maskil a song of insight or a skilful song. Swahili keeps them as names where the English does, and Readable follows the English Readable's best guess.

decisions.choice: mahalat leanot; masquil (L, B); una melodía para tiempos de sufrimiento; un canto para enseñar (R)
decisions.reason: The sense of mahalath leannoth and of maskil is no longer certain. Literal and Balanced keep them as names, in Spanish spelling ("masquil"), as the English keeps them; Readable gives their likeliest sense, as the English Readable does, with the same uncertainty.

decisions.choice: "ma-ha-lát lê-a-nốt" kept as a name (L, B); "theo điệu dành cho lúc khổ đau" (R)
decisions.reason: The words are probably a tune or a way of singing, and their sense is uncertain (see the meaning decision). Literal and Balanced keep them as a name; Readable gives the likely sense, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "bài Mát-kin" (L, B), "bài ca để dạy dỗ" (R); "Hê-man người Ếch-ra-hít"
decisions.reason: Maskil is kept as a name, as the terms for these books set, and Readable gives its likely sense. Heman and his clan name take the Protestant forms.

decisions.choice: "마할랏 르안놋" and "마스길" kept as names (L, B); explained at Readable as "고난의 때에 부르는 곡조" and "가르침과 깨달음을 주는 노래"
decisions.reason: These words are probably a tune and a kind of song whose exact meaning is lost (meaning decisions m4, m5). Literal and Balanced keep them as the terms note does; Readable follows the English Readable's explanation, which is uncertain.

decisions.choice: "에스라 사람 헤만"
decisions.reason: The usual Protestant form of the name and the clan (meaning decision m6).

decisions.choice: sobre maalate leanote
decisions.reason: The terms, whose sense is unknown (m4), are kept in Portuguese spelling, "maalate" as in the title of 53:1, lowercase like the other musical directions ("sobre a gitite", "sobre alamote"); Readable gives the likeliest sense, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in Amharic
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the English setting that capitalises pronouns for God has nothing to change in Amharic; the Amharic text has no deity_pronoun spans.

decisions.choice: mahalath leannoth as the name "በማሐላት ልዓኖት" (Literal, Balanced); Readable "በመከራ ጊዜ በሚዘመር ዜማ" as the English Readable; Heman the Ezrahite "ኢዝራሐዊው ሄማን", as 1 Kings 5:11 on main
decisions.reason: The heading words are of uncertain sense (the meaning decision), so Literal and Balanced keep them as a name, as the terms list does for maskil and miktam. Heman and the Ezrahite keep the forms of 1 Kings 5:11.

decisions.choice: महलत लअन्नोत, मस्कील (L, B); दुख के समय की धुन पर; शिक्षा और समझ देने के लिए गीत (R)
decisions.reason: The musical terms are kept as names at Literal and Balanced, as the English does and as Psalm 53:1 has महलत; Readable gives their likeliest sense (m4, m5), with maskil worded as in Psalms 42 and 52 in this translation. Heman the Ezrahite keeps the form of 1 Kings 5:11, एज्रेही हेमान, at every level.

decisions.choice: "Маскиль"; "на махалат леаннот"; "Еман езрахитянин"
decisions.reason: As the poetry note sets out, maskil and the terms whose meaning is lost stay names at Literal and Balanced and are explained at Readable, as the English does. Heman keeps the form of 1 Chronicles in this translation, and "езрахитянин" that of 1 Kings 4:31. Readable gives maskil as "Песня Емана езрахитянина, чтобы учить", as 78:1, and the sons of Korah as "из семьи Корея", as Psalm 48:1.

decisions.choice: 'al-machalat le'annot "マハラト・レアノトに合わせて" (L, B), "苦しみのときの調べに合わせる" (R, no quotes as the English R); maskil "マスキル" (L, B), "教えるための歌" (R); Heman ha'ezrachi "エズラ人ヘマン"
decisions.reason: Probably a tune or manner of singing (m4, uncertain), as 53:1 マハラト; maskil and Heman the Ezrahite in the Psalter's title forms (PSA-1, m5, m6).

source.text: יְ֭הוָה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יְשׁוּעָתִ֑י יוֹם־צָעַ֖קְתִּי בַלַּ֣יְלָה נֶגְדֶּֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: YHWH, God of my salvation, [by] day I have cried out, in the night before you.

en.L: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, God of my salvation, \q [by] day I have cried out, in the night [I am] before {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.B: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, God who saves me, \q I have cried for help by day, and at night I am before {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, my God, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are the one who saves me. \q I call to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} for help all day, and I keep calling at night.

fr.L: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, Dieu de mon salut, \q le jour j’ai crié, la nuit [je suis] devant {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.
fr.B: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, Dieu qui me sauves, \q le jour je crie au secours, et la nuit je suis devant {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, mon Dieu, c’est {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} qui me sauves. \q Toute la journée, je crie vers {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} pour avoir de l’aide, et la nuit je continue.

sw.L: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa wokovu wangu, \q mchana nimelia, usiku [niko] mbele {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.B: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu unayeniokoa, \q nimelia kuomba msaada mchana, na usiku niko mbele {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.R: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wangu, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ndiwe unayeniokoa. \q Ninakuita unisaidie mchana kutwa, na usiku ninaendelea kukuita.

es.L: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, Dios de mi salvación, \q de día he clamado, de noche [estoy] delante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.
es.B: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, Dios que me salvas, \q de día he clamado pidiendo ayuda, y de noche estoy delante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, Dios mío, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eres el que me salva. \q Te pido ayuda todo el día, y sigo clamando por la noche.

vi.L: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của sự cứu rỗi tôi, \q ban ngày tôi đã kêu la, ban đêm [tôi ở] trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời là Đấng giải cứu tôi, \q ban ngày tôi kêu xin giúp đỡ, và ban đêm tôi ở trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của tôi, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Đấng giải cứu tôi. \q Suốt ngày tôi kêu xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giúp đỡ, và ban đêm tôi vẫn tiếp tục kêu xin.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 제 구원의 하나님, \q 낮에 제가 부르짖었고, 밤에 주님 앞에 [있습니다].
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 저를 구원하시는 하나님, \q 낮에는 도와 달라고 부르짖었고, 밤에도 주님 앞에 있습니다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 나의 하나님, 주님은 저를 구원하시는 분이십니다. \q 저는 하루 종일 주님께 도와 달라고 부르짖고, 밤에도 계속 부르짖습니다.

pt.L: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, Deus da minha salvação, \q de dia eu clamei, de noite [estou] diante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.
pt.B: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, Deus que me salvas, \q de dia clamei por socorro, e de noite estou diante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.
pt.R: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, meu Deus, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} és aquele que me salva. \q Eu clamo a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} pedindo ajuda o dia todo, e continuo clamando de noite.

am.L: የመዳኔ አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ \q በቀን ጮኽኩ፤ በሌሊትም በፊትህ [ነኝ]።
am.B: የምታድነኝ አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ \q በቀን ርዳታ ለማግኘት ጮኽኩ፤ በሌሊትም በፊትህ ነኝ።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} አምላኬ ሆይ፣ የምታድነኝ አንተ ነህ። \q ቀኑን ሙሉ ርዳታ ለማግኘት ወደ አንተ እጮኻለሁ፤ ሌሊትም መጮኼን አላቋርጥም።

hi.L: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, मेरे उद्धार के परमेश्वर, \q दिन को मैंने दोहाई दी है, रात को [मैं] तेरे सामने [हूँ]।
hi.B: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, मुझे बचानेवाले परमेश्वर, \q दिन में मैंने सहायता के लिए दोहाई दी है, और रात को मैं तेरे सामने रहता हूँ।
hi.R: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, मेरे परमेश्वर, तू ही मुझे बचानेवाला है। \q मैं दिन भर सहायता के लिए तुझे पुकारता हूँ, और रात को भी पुकारता रहता हूँ।

ru.L: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, Боже спасения моего, \q днём я взывал, ночью [я] пред {{deity_pronoun:тобой|Тобой}}.
ru.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, Боже, мой Спаситель, \q днём я кричал о помощи, и ночью я пред {{deity_pronoun:тобой|Тобой}}.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, мой Бог, {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} — тот, кто спасает меня. \q Я зову {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}} на помощь весь день и продолжаю звать ночью.

ja.L: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}、わたしの救いの神よ、 \q 昼、わたしは叫び、夜は、あなたの前に[いる]。
ja.B: わたしを救ってくださる神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、 \q 昼は助けを求めて叫び、夜はあなたの前にいる。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}、わたしの神よ、あなたこそ、わたしを救ってくださる方だ。 \q わたしは一日中、あなたに助けを求め、夜になっても呼び続ける。

decisions.choice: God of my salvation: the one hope in the psalm
decisions.reason: Psalm 88 has no turn to praise and ends in darkness. Its one hope is that the psalmist still calls the LORD "God of my salvation" and keeps praying to him (verses 10, 14).

decisions.choice: by day I cried, at night before you
alternatives: by day I cry out, and by night, before you
decisions.reason: The two halves of the line are day and night: he cries to God all the time. The second half has no verb; "I am" (or "I cry") is understood.

decisions.choice: [I am]
decisions.reason: Literal brackets the verb the second half implies (m2).

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans
decisions.reason: Devanagari has no capital letters, so the deity_pronoun setting has nothing to change in Hindi; the psalmist speaks to God with the devotional तू from beginning to end.

decisions.choice: 'Elohei yeshu'ati "わたしの救いの神" (L), "わたしを救ってくださる神" (B), "わたしを救ってくださる方" (R)
decisions.reason: God of my salvation is the one hope named in the psalm (m1); B and R make it a clause as the English does.

records.literal_gloss: May my prayer come before you; incline your ear to my cry.

en.L: Let my prayer come before {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}; \q incline {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} ear to my cry.
en.B: Let my prayer make its way into {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} presence; \q bend down and hear me as I cry.
en.R: Please hear my prayer. \q Listen when I cry out to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.

fr.L: Que ma prière parvienne devant {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} ; \q incline {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} oreille à mon cri.
fr.B: Que ma prière arrive jusqu’en {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} présence ; \q penche-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} pour entendre mon cri.
fr.R: Écoute ma prière, s’il {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} plaît. \q Entends-moi quand je crie vers {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.

sw.L: Maombi yangu yafike mbele {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}; \q utege sikio {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} kwa kilio changu.
sw.B: Maombi yangu yafike mbele {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}; \q uiname unisikie ninapolia.
sw.R: Tafadhali sikia maombi yangu. \q Unisikilize ninapokulilia.

es.L: Llegue mi oración delante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}; \q inclina {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} oído a mi clamor.
es.B: Que mi oración llegue hasta {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} presencia; \q inclínate y escúchame cuando clamo.
es.R: Por favor, oye mi oración. \q Escúchame cuando clamo a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.

vi.L: Nguyện lời cầu nguyện của tôi đến trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q xin nghiêng tai {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nghe tiếng kêu của tôi.
vi.B: Nguyện lời cầu nguyện của tôi thấu đến trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q xin cúi xuống nghe tiếng tôi kêu van.
vi.R: Xin nghe lời tôi cầu nguyện. \q Xin lắng nghe khi tôi kêu cầu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 제 기도가 주님 앞에 이르게 하시고, \q 제 부르짖음에 주님의 귀를 기울여 주십시오.
ko.B: 제 기도가 주님 앞에 닿게 해 주십시오. \q 몸을 굽히시고 제 부르짖음을 들어 주십시오.
ko.R: 제발 제 기도를 들어 주십시오. \q 제가 주님께 부르짖을 때 귀를 기울여 주십시오.

pt.L: Chegue a minha oração diante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}; \q inclina o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} ouvido ao meu clamor.
pt.B: Que a minha oração chegue à {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} presença; \q inclina-te e ouve-me quando eu clamo.
pt.R: Por favor, ouve a minha oração. \q Escuta quando eu clamo a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.

am.L: ጸሎቴ በፊትህ ይድረስ፤ \q ጆሮህን ወደ ጩኸቴ አዘንብል።
am.B: ጸሎቴ ወደ አንተ ፊት ይግባ፤ \q ስጮኽ ዝቅ ብለህ ስማኝ።
am.R: እባክህ ጸሎቴን ስማ። \q ወደ አንተ ስጮኽ አድምጠኝ።

hi.L: मेरी प्रार्थना तेरे सामने पहुँचे; \q मेरी पुकार की ओर अपना कान झुका।
hi.B: मेरी प्रार्थना तेरे सम्मुख पहुँचे; \q झुककर मेरी पुकार सुन।
hi.R: कृपया मेरी प्रार्थना सुन। \q जब मैं तुझे पुकारूँ, तब मेरी सुन।

ru.L: Пусть дойдёт до {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}} моя молитва; \q приклони {{deity_pronoun:твоё|Твоё}} ухо к моему воплю.
ru.B: Пусть моя молитва дойдёт до {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}}; \q склонись и услышь, как я кричу.
ru.R: Пожалуйста, услышь мою молитву. \q Выслушай меня, когда я кричу {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}.

ja.L: わたしの祈りが、あなたの前に届くように。 \q わたしの叫びに、耳を傾けてください。
ja.B: わたしの祈りが、あなたのもとに届くように。 \q 身をかがめて、わたしの叫びを聞いてください。
ja.R: どうか、わたしの祈りを聞いてください。 \q わたしが叫ぶとき、耳を傾けてください。

decisions.choice: my cry: a loud, ringing cry
decisions.reason: The word (rinnah) is often a ringing shout of joy (30:6); here it is a loud cry for help (17:1).

decisions.choice: incline your ear: listen closely
decisions.reason: As in 86:1.

decisions.choice: hatteh-'ozneka "耳を傾けてください" (L, R), "身をかがめて…聞いてください" (B)
decisions.reason: Inclining the ear is listening closely (m2).

source.text: כִּֽי־שָֽׂבְעָ֣ה בְרָע֣וֹת נַפְשִׁ֑י וְחַיַּ֗י לִשְׁא֥וֹל הִגִּֽיעוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: For full with troubles [is] my soul, and my life to Sheol has drawn near.

en.L: For my soul is full of troubles, \q and my life has drawn near to Sheol.
en.B: For I have had my fill of troubles, \q and my life has come to the edge of Sheol.
en.R: My life is filled to the top with trouble. \q I am close to the place of the dead.

fr.L: Car mon âme est rassasiée de malheurs, \q et ma vie s’est approchée du Shéol.
fr.B: Car j’ai eu mon compte de malheurs, \q et ma vie touche au bord du séjour des morts.
fr.R: Ma vie est remplie de malheurs jusqu’au bord. \q Je suis tout près du séjour des morts.

sw.L: Kwa maana nafsi yangu imejaa taabu, \q na uhai wangu umekaribia Kuzimu.
sw.B: Kwa maana nimeshiba taabu, \q na maisha yangu yamefika ukingoni mwa Kuzimu.
sw.R: Maisha yangu yamejaa taabu mpaka pomoni. \q Niko karibu na Kuzimu, mahali pa wafu.

es.L: Porque mi alma está llena de males, \q y mi vida se ha acercado al Seol.
es.B: Porque ya estoy harto de desgracias, \q y mi vida ha llegado al borde del lugar de los muertos.
es.R: Mi vida está llena de problemas hasta el borde. \q Estoy cerca del lugar de los muertos.

vi.L: Vì linh hồn tôi đầy những gian nan, \q và mạng sống tôi đã đến gần Âm Phủ.
vi.B: Vì tôi đã chịu quá đủ những gian truân, \q và mạng sống tôi đã kề bên bờ Âm Phủ.
vi.R: Đời tôi đầy ắp những khó khăn. \q Tôi đã gần đến nơi của người chết.

ko.L: 제 영혼이 고난으로 가득하고, \q 제 생명이 스올에 가까이 이르렀기 때문입니다.
ko.B: 저는 고난을 겪을 만큼 겪었고, \q 제 목숨은 스올 문턱에 이르렀습니다.
ko.R: 제 삶은 고통으로 꽉 차 있습니다. \q 저는 죽은 사람들이 있는 곳에 가까이 와 있습니다.

pt.L: Pois a minha alma está cheia de males, \q e a minha vida chegou perto do Sheol.
pt.B: Pois já estou farto de desgraças, \q e a minha vida chegou à beira do mundo dos mortos.
pt.R: A minha vida está cheia de problemas até a borda. \q Estou perto do mundo dos mortos.

am.L: ነፍሴ በመከራ ተሞልታለችና፤ \q ሕይወቴም ወደ ሲኦል ቀርባለች።
am.B: መከራ ጠግቤአለሁና፤ \q ሕይወቴም የሙታን ዓለም ዳርቻ ደርሳለች።
am.R: ሕይወቴ ጢም ብሎ በችግር ተሞልቷል። \q ወደ ሙታን ዓለም ተቃርቤአለሁ።

hi.L: क्योंकि मेरा प्राण विपत्तियों से भरा है, \q और मेरा जीवन शिओल के निकट पहुँच गया है।
hi.B: क्योंकि मैं विपत्तियों से भर गया हूँ, \q और मेरा जीवन अधोलोक के किनारे आ पहुँचा है।
hi.R: मेरा जीवन मुसीबतों से लबालब भर गया है। \q मैं मृत्यु के लोक के पास पहुँच गया हूँ।

ru.L: Ведь душа моя полна бед, \q и жизнь моя приблизилась к шеолу.
ru.B: Ведь я сыт бедами по горло, \q и моя жизнь подошла к краю мира мёртвых.
ru.R: Моя жизнь до краёв наполнена бедами. \q Я близок к миру мёртвых.

ja.L: わたしの魂は苦しみに満ち、 \q わたしの命は陰府に近づいた。
ja.B: わたしは、苦しみをいやというほど味わい、 \q わたしの命は、陰府の入り口にまで来ている。
ja.R: わたしの人生は、苦しみであふれている。 \q わたしは、死者の世界のすぐ近くにいる。

decisions.choice: full: had one's fill
decisions.reason: The verb (sava') is used for eating one's fill. Here it is a bitter picture: he has been fed on trouble until he can take no more.

decisions.choice: Sheol: the place of the dead
decisions.reason: As in 6:6.

decisions.choice: I (B); my life (R)
decisions.reason: Nefesh is the whole living self; Literal keeps "soul".

decisions.choice: She'ol "陰府" (L, B), "死者の世界" (R)
decisions.reason: Sheol is the place of the dead (m2), in the Psalter's forms (PSA-1).

source.text: נֶ֭חְשַׁבְתִּי עִם־י֣וֹרְדֵי ב֑וֹר הָ֝יִ֗יתִי כְּגֶ֣בֶר אֵֽין־אֱיָֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: I am counted with those going down [to the] pit; I have become like a man without strength.

en.L: I am counted with those who go down [to the] pit; \q I have become like {{gender:someone|a man}} [who has] no strength.
en.B: I am reckoned with those who descend into the pit; \q I have become like someone with no strength left.
en.R: People think of me as already dead and buried. \q I have no strength left.

fr.L: Je suis compté avec ceux qui descendent [dans la] fosse ; \q je suis devenu comme {{gender:quelqu’un|un homme}} [qui n’a] pas de force.
fr.B: On me compte parmi ceux qui descendent dans la fosse ; \q je suis devenu comme quelqu’un qui n’a plus de force.
fr.R: Les gens me voient comme si j’étais déjà mort et enterré. \q Je n’ai plus de force.

sw.L: Nimehesabiwa pamoja na wale washukao shimoni; \q nimekuwa kama mtu asiye na nguvu.
sw.B: Nimehesabiwa kati ya wale wanaoshuka shimoni; \q nimekuwa kama mtu aliyeishiwa nguvu.
sw.R: Watu wananiona kama mtu aliyekwisha kufa na kuzikwa. \q Sina nguvu tena.

es.L: Soy contado entre los que descienden [a la] fosa; \q he llegado a ser como {{gender:alguien|un hombre}} [que] no [tiene] fuerzas.
es.B: Me cuentan entre los que bajan a la fosa; \q he llegado a ser como alguien a quien no le quedan fuerzas.
es.R: La gente piensa que ya estoy muerto y enterrado. \q No me quedan fuerzas.

vi.L: Tôi bị kể vào số những người đi xuống huyệt; \q tôi đã trở nên như người [không còn] sức lực.
vi.B: Tôi bị xem như những kẻ đi xuống huyệt sâu; \q tôi đã trở nên như người cạn hết sức lực.
vi.R: Người ta coi tôi như đã chết và bị chôn rồi. \q Tôi không còn chút sức lực nào.

ko.L: 제가 구덩이로 내려가는 자들과 함께 여겨지고, \q 힘이 [없는] 사람처럼 되었습니다.
ko.B: 저는 무덤으로 내려가는 사람들 가운데 하나로 여겨지고, \q 힘이 다 빠진 사람같이 되었습니다.
ko.R: 사람들은 제가 이미 죽어서 묻힌 사람이라고 생각합니다. \q 저에게는 힘이 하나도 남아 있지 않습니다.

pt.L: Sou contado com os que descem [à] cova; \q tornei-me como {{gender:alguém|um homem}} [que] não tem força.
pt.B: Sou contado entre os que descem à cova; \q tornei-me como alguém que já não tem forças.
pt.R: As pessoas pensam que já estou morto e enterrado. \q Não tenho mais forças.

am.L: ወደ ጉድጓድ ከሚወርዱት ጋር ተቆጠርኩ፤ \q ኃይል እንደሌለው ሰው ሆንኩ።
am.B: ወደ ጉድጓድ ከሚወርዱት ጋር ተቆጠርኩ፤ \q ምንም ብርታት እንዳልቀረለት ሰው ሆንኩ።
am.R: ሰዎች እንደ ሞተና እንደ ተቀበረ ይቆጥሩኛል። \q ምንም ኃይል አልቀረልኝም።

hi.L: मैं गड्ढे में उतरनेवालों में गिना जाता हूँ; \q मैं {{gender:ऐसे व्यक्ति|ऐसे पुरुष}} के समान हो गया हूँ जिसमें बल नहीं।
hi.B: मैं क़ब्र में उतरनेवालों में गिना जाता हूँ; \q मैं ऐसे व्यक्ति के समान हो गया हूँ जिसमें कोई बल नहीं बचा।
hi.R: लोग मुझे ऐसा समझते हैं मानो मैं मरकर गाड़ा जा चुका हूँ। \q मुझमें कोई बल नहीं बचा।

ru.L: Я причислен к нисходящим в яму; \q я стал как человек, [у которого] нет силы.
ru.B: Меня считают одним из тех, кто сходит в могилу; \q я стал как тот, у кого не осталось сил.
ru.R: Люди думают обо мне, будто я уже умер и похоронен. \q У меня не осталось сил.

ja.L: わたしは、穴に下る者たちと共に数えられ、 \q 力のない人のようになった。
ja.B: わたしは、穴に下る者たちの一人に数えられ、 \q 力の尽き果てた人のようになった。
ja.R: 人々は、わたしを、もう死んで葬られた者のように思っている。 \q わたしには、もう力が残っていない。

decisions.choice: the pit: the grave, the way down to Sheol
decisions.reason: The pit (bor) is a cistern or a grave; "those who go down to the pit" are the dying (28:1; 30:4).

decisions.choice: a man without strength
decisions.reason: The word for man (gever) suggests a strong man. He is a man in name, but the strength is gone.

decisions.choice: people think of me as already dead and buried
alternatives: I am counted with those who go down to the pit
decisions.reason: Readable says what the picture means (m1).

decisions.choice: {{gender:alguém|um homem}}
decisions.reason: As the English Literal: the word (gever, m2) names a man, but the comparison holds for anyone; the default says "alguém", the traditional alternative "um homem".

decisions.choice: no gender span: "ሰው"
decisions.reason: "ሰው" already covers men and women, so the English span between "someone" and "a man" has no second Amharic wording.

decisions.choice: गड्ढा (L); क़ब्र (B, R)
decisions.reason: The pit is the grave, the way down to Sheol (m1); as the poetry note settles, Literal keeps the picture of the pit and Balanced says the grave. The man without strength is under the gender setting at Literal, as in the English, with व्यक्ति by default.

decisions.choice: "человек" with no gender setting
decisions.reason: The English Literal offers "someone" or "a man" as a setting. Russian "человек" reads either way and needs no setting, as the Pentateuch note settles. The pit is "яма" at Literal and "могила" at Balanced, as the poetry note sets out. The same at Readable, and in verse 7 at Balanced and Readable.

decisions.choice: bor "穴" (L, B); R as the English R "already dead and buried"
decisions.reason: The pit is the grave, the way down to Sheol (m1), bor 穴 as PSA-1.

decisions.choice: "人" with no gender span where the English L has {{gender:someone|a man}}
decisions.reason: Japanese 人 is already inclusive (style guide 7).

source.text: בַּמֵּתִ֗ים חָ֫פְשִׁ֥י כְּמ֤וֹ חֲלָלִ֨ים׀שֹׁ֥כְבֵי קֶ֗בֶר אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹ֣א זְכַרְתָּ֣ם ע֑וֹד וְ֝הֵ֗מָּה מִיָּדְךָ֥ נִגְזָֽרוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Among the dead free, like [the] slain lying [in the] grave, whom not you remember anymore, and they from your hand are cut off.

en.L: Among the dead [I am] set free, \q like [the] slain who lie [in the] grave, whom {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} remember no more, \q and they are cut off from {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} hand.
en.B: I am turned loose among the dead, \q like those killed in battle who lie buried, whom {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} no longer keep in mind, \q who are beyond the reach of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} hand.
en.R: I have been left among the dead, \q like people killed in battle and buried. \q You do not remember them anymore. They are cut off from {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} help.

fr.L: Parmi les morts [je suis] laissé libre, \q comme [les] tués qui sont couchés [dans la] tombe, dont {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ne {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} souviens plus, \q et qui sont retranchés de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} main.
fr.B: On m’a lâché parmi les morts, \q comme ceux qui sont tombés au combat et sont enterrés, à qui {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ne penses plus, \q qui sont hors de portée de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} main.
fr.R: On m’a laissé parmi les morts, \q comme des gens tués à la guerre et enterrés. \q Tu ne {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} souviens plus d’eux. Ils sont coupés de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} aide.

sw.L: Kati ya wafu [nimeachwa] huru, \q kama waliouawa walalao kaburini, ambao {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} huwakumbuki tena, \q nao wamekatiliwa mbali na mkono {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}.
sw.B: Nimeachwa huru kati ya wafu, \q kama waliouawa vitani waliozikwa, ambao huwakumbuki tena, \q walio mbali na kufikiwa na mkono {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}.
sw.R: Nimeachwa kati ya wafu, \q kama watu waliouawa vitani na kuzikwa. \q Huwakumbuki tena. Wamekatiliwa mbali na msaada {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}.

es.L: Entre los muertos [estoy] suelto, \q como [los] caídos que yacen [en el] sepulcro, de quienes ya no {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} acuerdas, \q y que están separados de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} mano.
es.B: Me han dejado suelto entre los muertos, \q como los caídos en batalla que yacen enterrados, de quienes ya no {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} acuerdas, \q que están fuera del alcance de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} mano.
es.R: Me han dejado entre los muertos, \q como la gente que murió en la batalla y fue enterrada. \q Tú ya no {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} acuerdas de ellos. Están lejos de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ayuda.

vi.L: Giữa những người chết, [tôi bị] thả lỏng, \q như [những kẻ] bị giết nằm [trong] mồ, những kẻ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không còn nhớ đến nữa, \q và họ bị cắt khỏi tay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Tôi bị bỏ mặc giữa những người chết, \q như những người tử trận nằm dưới mồ, những người {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không còn nhớ đến, \q những người ở ngoài tầm tay của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Tôi bị bỏ lại giữa những người chết, \q như những người bị giết trong chiến trận và bị chôn. \q Ngài không còn nhớ đến họ nữa. Họ bị cắt đứt khỏi sự giúp đỡ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 죽은 자들 가운데 [제가] 내버려졌으니, \q 무덤에 누운 살해된 자들 같습니다. 주님께서 더 이상 기억하지 않으시는 그들은 \q 주님의 손에서 끊어졌습니다.
ko.B: 저는 죽은 사람들 사이에 버려졌습니다. \q 전쟁에서 죽어 무덤에 누운 사람들, 주님께서 더는 기억하지 않으시는 사람들 같습니다. \q 그들은 주님의 손길이 닿지 않는 곳에 있습니다.
ko.R: 저는 죽은 사람들 가운데 버려졌습니다. \q 전쟁에서 죽어 묻힌 사람들과 같습니다. \q 주님께서는 그들을 더 이상 기억하지 않으십니다. 그들은 주님의 도움에서 끊어졌습니다.

pt.L: Entre os mortos [estou] solto, \q como [os] mortos à espada que jazem [na] sepultura, dos quais {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} não te lembras mais, \q e eles estão cortados da {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} mão.
pt.B: Fui largado entre os mortos, \q como os que caíram na batalha e jazem sepultados, de quem {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} já não te lembras, \q que estão fora do alcance da {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} mão.
pt.R: Fui deixado entre os mortos, \q como as pessoas mortas na guerra e enterradas. \q Tu não te lembras mais delas. Elas estão longe da {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} ajuda.

am.L: በሙታን መካከል ነጻ [ሆንኩ]፤ \q በመቃብር እንደሚተኙ እንደ ተገደሉት፣ ከእንግዲህ እንደማታስባቸው፣ \q እነርሱም ከእጅህ እንደ ተቆረጡት።
am.B: በሙታን መካከል ተጥያለሁ፤ \q በጦርነት ተገድለው እንደ ተቀበሩት፣ ከእንግዲህ እንደማታስታውሳቸው፣ \q እጅህ እንደማይደርስላቸው ሆኛለሁ።
am.R: በሙታን መካከል ተተውኩ፤ \q በጦርነት እንደ ተገደሉና እንደ ተቀበሩ ሰዎች ሆንኩ። \q አንተ ከእንግዲህ አታስታውሳቸውም፤ ከርዳታህም ተለይተዋል።

hi.L: मरे हुओं के बीच [मैं] छोड़ दिया गया हूँ, \q उन मारे गए [लोगों] के समान जो क़ब्र में पड़े हैं, जिन्हें तू फिर स्मरण नहीं करता, \q और वे तेरे हाथ से अलग कर दिए गए हैं।
hi.B: मैं मरे हुओं के बीच छोड़ दिया गया हूँ, \q युद्ध में मारे गए उन लोगों के समान जो गाड़े पड़े हैं, जिनकी तू अब सुधि नहीं लेता, \q जो तेरे हाथ की पहुँच से बाहर हैं।
hi.R: मुझे मरे हुओं के बीच छोड़ दिया गया है, \q युद्ध में मारे गए और गाड़े गए लोगों की तरह। \q तू उन्हें अब याद नहीं करता। वे तेरी सहायता से कट गए हैं।

ru.L: Среди мёртвых [я] брошен, \q как убитые, лежащие в могиле, которых {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} больше не помнишь, \q и они отрезаны от {{deity_pronoun:твоей|Твоей}} руки.
ru.B: Я оставлен среди мёртвых, \q как павшие в битве, что лежат в могиле, о которых {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} больше не вспоминаешь, \q которые вне досягаемости {{deity_pronoun:твоей|Твоей}} руки.
ru.R: Меня бросили среди мёртвых, \q как людей, убитых в бою и похороненных. \q Ты их больше не помнишь. Они отрезаны от {{deity_pronoun:твоей|Твоей}} помощи.

ja.L: 死者たちの中に、[わたしは]放り出され、 \q 墓に横たわる殺された者たちのよう。あなたは、もはや彼らを思い起こすことはなさらず、 \q 彼らは、あなたの手から断たれている。
ja.B: わたしは、死者たちの中に捨て置かれ、 \q 戦いで殺されて葬られた者たちのようだ。あなたは、もはや彼らを思い起こすことはなさらない。 \q 彼らは、あなたの手の届かない所にいる。
ja.R: わたしは、死んだ人たちの中に置き去りにされた。 \q 戦いで殺されて、葬られた人たちのように。 \q あなたは、もう彼らのことを覚えてはくださらない。彼らは、あなたの助けから切り離されている。

decisions.choice: free: cut loose, left to oneself
decisions.reason: The word (chofshi) is used for a slave set free (Exodus 21:2). Among the dead it is a bitter freedom: released from life and from God's care.

decisions.choice: cut off from your hand: beyond your help
decisions.reason: God's hand is his power to act and save. The dead, as the psalmist sees them, are out of its reach and out of his mind.

decisions.choice: the slain: those killed in battle
decisions.reason: The word (chalal) is used for the fallen in war, left in a common grave (Ezekiel 32:20-32).

decisions.choice: chofshi "放り出され" (L), "捨て置かれ" (B), "置き去りにされた" (R); lo' zekhartam "思い起こすことはなさらない" (L, B), "覚えてはくださらない" (R)
decisions.reason: Free is cut loose, left to oneself (m1, uncertain); cut off from the hand is beyond God's help (m2). The negative for God avoids 〜られない (PSA-1).

records.literal_gloss: You have put me in [the] pit of [the] lowest [places], in dark places, in [the] depths.

en.L: You have put me in the lowest pit, \q in dark places, in the depths.
en.B: You have laid me at the bottom of the pit, \q in places of darkness, in the deep waters.
en.R: You have put me at the very bottom of the pit, \q in the dark, deep down.

fr.L: Tu m’as mis dans la fosse la plus basse, \q dans des lieux obscurs, dans les profondeurs.
fr.B: Tu m’as couché au fond de la fosse, \q dans des lieux de ténèbres, dans les eaux profondes.
fr.R: Tu m’as mis tout au fond de la fosse, \q dans le noir, très profond.

sw.L: Umeniweka katika shimo la chini kabisa, \q mahali penye giza, vilindini.
sw.B: Umenilaza chini kabisa shimoni, \q mahali penye giza, katika maji ya vilindi.
sw.R: Umeniweka chini kabisa shimoni, \q gizani, chini sana.

es.L: Me has puesto en la fosa más profunda, \q en lugares oscuros, en las profundidades.
es.B: Me has echado al fondo de la fosa, \q a lugares de tinieblas, a las aguas profundas.
es.R: Me has puesto en lo más hondo del pozo, \q en la oscuridad, muy abajo.

vi.L: Ngài đã đặt tôi trong huyệt thấp nhất, \q trong những nơi tối tăm, trong vực sâu.
vi.B: Ngài đã đặt tôi dưới đáy huyệt, \q trong chốn tối tăm, nơi nước sâu thẳm.
vi.R: Ngài đã đặt tôi dưới tận đáy hố sâu, \q trong bóng tối, dưới tận sâu thẳm.

ko.L: 주님께서 저를 가장 깊은 구덩이에, \q 어두운 곳들에, 깊은 물속에 두셨습니다.
ko.B: 주님께서 저를 구덩이 맨 밑바닥에, \q 캄캄한 곳, 깊은 물속에 눕히셨습니다.
ko.R: 주님께서 저를 구덩이 맨 밑바닥에 두셨습니다. \q 어둡고 깊은 곳에 두셨습니다.

pt.L: Tu me puseste na cova mais profunda, \q em lugares escuros, nas profundezas.
pt.B: Tu me deitaste no fundo da cova, \q em lugares de trevas, nas águas profundas.
pt.R: Tu me puseste bem no fundo da cova, \q no escuro, lá embaixo.

am.L: በታችኛው ጉድጓድ ውስጥ አኖርከኝ፤ \q በጨለማ ስፍራዎች፣ በጥልቆች ውስጥ።
am.B: በጉድጓዱ ታች አስተኛኸኝ፤ \q በጨለማ ስፍራዎች፣ በጥልቅ ውኆች ውስጥ።
am.R: በጉድጓዱ እጅግ ታች አኖርከኝ፤ \q በጨለማ ውስጥ፣ በጣም ጥልቅ ስፍራ።

hi.L: तूने मुझे सबसे नीचे के गड्ढे में, \q अँधेरे स्थानों में, गहराइयों में रख दिया है।
hi.B: तूने मुझे क़ब्र की तली में डाल दिया है, \q अंधकार के स्थानों में, गहरे जल में।
hi.R: तूने मुझे क़ब्र की बिलकुल तली में डाल दिया है, \q अँधेरे में, बहुत गहराई में।

ru.L: Ты положил меня в самую нижнюю яму, \q во тьму, в глубины.
ru.B: Ты уложил меня на дно могилы, \q в места тьмы, в глубокие воды.
ru.R: Ты бросил меня на самое дно могилы, \q в темноту, в глубину.

ja.L: あなたは、わたしを最も深い穴に置かれた。 \q 暗い所、深い淵に。
ja.B: あなたは、わたしを穴の底に置かれた。 \q 闇の中に、深い水の中に。
ja.R: あなたは、わたしを穴のいちばん底に置かれた。 \q 暗くて、深い所に。

decisions.choice: you have put me: God is the one who has done it
decisions.reason: The psalmist does not blame his enemies or chance. Again and again he says that God has done this to him (verses 7-9, 17-19). The psalm leaves the complaint standing.

decisions.choice: the depths: the deep places of the sea
decisions.reason: The word (metsolot) is used of the sea's depths (Exodus 15:5; 69:3). The grave and the deep waters are both pictures of death.

decisions.choice: गड्ढा (L); क़ब्र (B, R)
decisions.reason: The pit is the grave, as in verse 5; as the poetry note settles, Literal keeps the picture of the pit and Balanced and Readable say the grave, so the word is the same in both verses.

decisions.choice: metsolot "深い淵" (L), "深い水" (B), "深い所" (R)
decisions.reason: God is the one who has done it (m1); the depths are the deep places of the sea (m2).

source.text: עָ֭לַי סָמְכָ֣ה חֲמָתֶ֑ךָ וְכָל־מִ֝שְׁבָּרֶ֗יךָ עִנִּ֥יתָ סֶּֽלָה׃

records.literal_gloss: On me has lain your wrath, and [with] all your breakers you have afflicted [me]. Selah.

en.L: Upon me {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} wrath has lain heavy, \q and with all {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} breakers {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have afflicted [me]. Selah
en.B: Your fury presses down on me; \q {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have crushed me under all {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} waves. Selah
en.R: Your anger lies heavy on me. \q You have sent wave after wave crashing over me. Selah

fr.L: Sur moi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} fureur a pesé, \q et par tous {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} brisants {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} [m’]as accablé. Sélah
fr.B: Ta fureur m’écrase de son poids ; \q {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’as brisé sous toutes {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} vagues. Sélah
fr.R: Ta colère pèse lourd sur moi. \q Tu as fait passer sur moi vague après vague. Sélah

sw.L: Juu yangu ghadhabu {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} imenilemea, \q na kwa mawimbi {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} yote umenitesa. Sela
sw.B: Hasira {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} kali inanilemea; \q umeniponda chini ya mawimbi {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} yote. Sela
sw.R: Hasira {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} inanilemea. \q Umeleta wimbi baada ya wimbi likinipiga. Sela

es.L: Sobre mí ha pesado {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ira, \q y con todas {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} olas [me] has afligido. Selah
es.B: Tu furor me oprime; \q me has aplastado bajo todas {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} olas. Selah
es.R: Tu enojo pesa sobre mí. \q Has mandado una ola tras otra a estrellarse sobre mí. Selah

vi.L: Cơn thịnh nộ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đè nặng trên tôi, \q và với mọi lớp sóng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm khổ [tôi]. Sê-la
vi.B: Cơn thịnh nộ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đè nặng trên tôi; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã nhận chìm tôi dưới mọi đợt sóng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Sê-la
vi.R: Cơn giận của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đè nặng trên tôi. \q Ngài đã cho hết đợt sóng này đến đợt sóng khác ập xuống trên tôi. Sê-la

ko.L: 제 위에 주님의 진노가 무겁게 놓였고, \q 주님의 모든 파도로 [저를] 괴롭히셨습니다. 셀라
ko.B: 주님의 분노가 저를 짓누르고, \q 주님께서 주님의 모든 파도로 저를 덮치셨습니다. 셀라
ko.R: 주님의 노여움이 저를 무겁게 누릅니다. \q 주님께서 파도를 잇달아 보내셔서 저를 덮치게 하셨습니다. 셀라

pt.L: Sobre mim pesa a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} ira, \q e com todos os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} vagalhões {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} [me] afligiste. Selá
pt.B: O {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} furor me esmaga; \q {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me afundaste debaixo de todas as {{deity_pronoun:tuas|Tuas}} ondas. Selá
pt.R: A {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} ira pesa sobre mim. \q Tu mandaste onda após onda quebrar em cima de mim. Selá

am.L: ቁጣህ በእኔ ላይ ከብዷል፤ \q በማዕበሎችህም ሁሉ አስጨነቅኸኝ። ሴላ
am.B: መዓትህ ይጫነኛል፤ \q በማዕበሎችህ ሁሉ አደቀቅኸኝ። ሴላ
am.R: ቁጣህ በእኔ ላይ ከብዶብኛል። \q ማዕበል በማዕበል ላይ እየላክህ አጥለቀለቅኸኝ። ሴላ

hi.L: तेरा कोप मुझ पर भारी पड़ा है, \q और तूने अपनी सब लहरों से [मुझे] दुख दिया है। सेला
hi.B: तेरा रोष मुझे दबाए हुए है; \q तूने मुझे अपनी सब लहरों के नीचे कुचल दिया है। सेला
hi.R: तेरा क्रोध मुझ पर भारी है। \q तूने एक के बाद एक लहर मुझ पर चढ़ा दी है। सेला

ru.L: На мне тяжело лежит {{deity_pronoun:твоя|Твоя}} ярость, \q и всеми {{deity_pronoun:твоими|Твоими}} волнами {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} поразил [меня]. Села
ru.B: Твоя ярость давит на меня; \q {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} сокрушил меня всеми {{deity_pronoun:твоими|Твоими}} волнами. Села
ru.R: Твой гнев тяжело лежит на мне. \q Ты обрушил на меня волну за волной. Села

ja.L: わたしの上に、あなたの憤りが重くのしかかり、 \q あなたは、あなたのすべての砕ける波で、[わたしを]苦しめておられる。セラ
ja.B: あなたの激しい怒りが、わたしを押しつぶし、 \q あなたは、そのすべての波で、わたしを打ち砕かれた。セラ
ja.R: あなたの怒りが、わたしに重くのしかかっている。 \q あなたは、波を次から次へと送って、わたしを打ちのめされた。セラ

decisions.choice: has lain: rests its weight on me
decisions.reason: The verb (samakh) means to lean or press on something; God's anger rests its full weight on him.

decisions.choice: your breakers: the waves that break over a drowning man
decisions.reason: The same picture is in 42:8 ("all your breakers and your waves have passed over me") and in Jonah's prayer from the deep (Jonah 2).

decisions.choice: Selah: a word whose meaning is no longer known
alternatives: lift up (the voice or the music)
decisions.reason: Selah stands at the end of a line 71 times in the Psalms and 3 times in Habakkuk 3. It is probably a direction for singing or music, perhaps a pause or an interlude; the ancient Greek translation renders it with a word meaning "interlude". It is not part of what is said, and here it marks a break after the line.

decisions.choice: Selah, kept as it is
decisions.reason: Its meaning is unknown (see the meaning decision on Selah), so every level keeps the word rather than guess, and keeps it apart from the sentence.

decisions.choice: सेला, kept at the end of the verse
decisions.reason: Selah's meaning is no longer known, probably a direction for the music; every level keeps the word at the end of the verse, as the English does.

decisions.choice: samekhah "重くのしかかり" (L, R), "押しつぶし" (B); mishbareikha "砕ける波" (L), "波" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The wrath rests its weight on him (m1); the breakers are the waves that break over a drowning man (m2).

source.text: הִרְחַ֥קְתָּ מְיֻדָּעַ֗י מִ֫מֶּ֥נִּי שַׁתַּ֣נִי תוֹעֵב֣וֹת לָ֑מוֹ כָּ֝לֻ֗א וְלֹ֣א אֵצֵֽא׃

records.literal_gloss: You have put far my acquaintances from me; you have made me abominations to them; shut in, and not I go out.

en.L: You have removed my acquaintances far from me; \q {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have made me an abomination to them; \q [I am] shut in, and I cannot go out.
en.B: You have driven my friends away from me \q and made me loathsome to them; \q I am shut in, with no way out.
en.R: You have made my friends stay away from me. \q They find me disgusting. \q I am trapped like a prisoner, and I cannot get out.

fr.L: Tu as éloigné de moi mes connaissances ; \q {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as fait de moi une horreur pour eux ; \q [je suis] enfermé, et je ne sors pas.
fr.B: Tu as éloigné de moi mes amis \q et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’as rendu odieux à leurs yeux ; \q je suis enfermé, sans issue.
fr.R: Tu as fait que mes amis restent loin de moi. \q Je les dégoûte. \q Je suis coincé comme un prisonnier, et je ne peux pas sortir.

sw.L: Umewaweka mbali nami wanaonijua; \q umenifanya kuwa chukizo kwao; \q [nimefungiwa] ndani, wala siwezi kutoka.
sw.B: Umewafukuza rafiki zangu mbali nami \q ukanifanya kuwa kitu cha kuchukiza kwao; \q nimefungiwa ndani, bila njia ya kutoka.
sw.R: Umewafanya rafiki zangu wakae mbali nami. \q Wananiona kuwa kitu cha kuchukiza. \q Nimefungiwa kama mfungwa, wala siwezi kutoka.

es.L: Has alejado de mí a mis conocidos; \q me has hecho abominación para ellos; \q [estoy] encerrado, y no puedo salir.
es.B: Has apartado de mí a mis amigos \q y me has hecho repugnante para ellos; \q estoy encerrado, sin salida.
es.R: Has hecho que mis amigos se alejen de mí. \q Les doy asco. \q Estoy atrapado como un preso, y no puedo salir.

vi.L: Ngài đã đem những người quen biết tôi đi xa khỏi tôi; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm cho tôi thành điều ghê tởm đối với họ; \q [tôi bị] giam kín, và tôi không ra được.
vi.B: Ngài đã làm cho bạn bè xa lánh tôi \q và khiến họ ghê tởm tôi; \q tôi bị giam hãm, không lối thoát.
vi.R: Ngài đã làm cho bạn bè tránh xa tôi. \q Họ thấy tôi thật ghê tởm. \q Tôi bị nhốt như một tù nhân, và tôi không thể ra ngoài.

ko.L: 주님께서 제 아는 이들을 저에게서 멀리 떠나게 하시고, \q 저를 그들에게 역겨운 것이 되게 하셨습니다. \q [저는] 갇혀서 나갈 수 없습니다.
ko.B: 주님께서 제 친구들을 저에게서 멀어지게 하시고 \q 그들이 저를 꺼리게 하셨습니다. \q 저는 갇혀서 빠져나갈 길이 없습니다.
ko.R: 주님께서 제 친구들이 저를 멀리하게 하셨습니다. \q 그들은 저를 보기 싫어합니다. \q 저는 감옥에 갇힌 사람처럼 빠져나갈 수가 없습니다.

pt.L: Afastaste de mim os meus conhecidos; \q {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me fizeste abominação para eles; \q [estou] fechado, e não posso sair.
pt.B: Afastaste de mim os meus amigos \q e me tornaste repugnante para eles; \q estou preso, sem saída.
pt.R: Tu fizeste os meus amigos ficarem longe de mim. \q Eles têm nojo de mim. \q Estou preso como um prisioneiro e não consigo sair.

am.L: የሚያውቁኝን ከእኔ አራቅሃቸው፤ \q በእነርሱ ዘንድ አስጸያፊ አደረግኸኝ፤ \q ተዘግቼአለሁ፤ መውጣትም አልችልም።
am.B: ወዳጆቼን ከእኔ አባረርካቸው፤ \q በእነርሱም ዘንድ የተጠላሁ አደረግኸኝ፤ \q ተዘግቶብኛል፤ መውጫም የለኝም።
am.R: ጓደኞቼ ከእኔ እንዲርቁ አደረግህ። \q እኔን ማየት ይጸየፋሉ። \q እንደ እስረኛ ተዘግቶብኛል፤ መውጣትም አልችልም።

hi.L: तूने मेरे परिचितों को मुझसे दूर कर दिया है; \q तूने मुझे उनके लिए घृणित बना दिया है; \q [मैं] बंद हूँ, और बाहर नहीं निकल सकता।
hi.B: तूने मेरे मित्रों को मुझसे दूर भगा दिया है \q और मुझे उनकी दृष्टि में घिनौना बना दिया है; \q मैं बंद पड़ा हूँ, निकलने का कोई रास्ता नहीं।
hi.R: तूने मेरे मित्रों को मुझसे दूर रहने दिया है। \q उन्हें मुझसे घिन आती है। \q मैं क़ैदी की तरह फँसा हूँ, और बाहर नहीं निकल सकता।

ru.L: Ты удалил от меня моих знакомых; \q {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} сделал меня мерзостью для них; \q [я] заперт и не могу выйти.
ru.B: Ты отогнал от меня моих друзей \q и сделал меня отвратительным для них; \q я заперт, и выхода нет.
ru.R: Ты сделал так, что мои друзья держатся от меня подальше. \q Я им противен. \q Я заперт, как узник, и не могу выбраться.

ja.L: あなたは、わたしの知人たちを、わたしから遠ざけ、 \q わたしを彼らにとって忌まわしいものとされた。 \q [わたしは]閉じ込められ、出ることができない。
ja.B: あなたは、わたしの友を、わたしから遠ざけ、 \q 彼らがわたしを忌み嫌うようにされた。 \q わたしは閉じ込められ、出口もない。
ja.R: あなたは、わたしの友だちを、わたしから遠ざけてしまわれた。 \q 彼らは、わたしを見るのもいやがる。 \q わたしは、囚人のように閉じ込められて、外に出ることができない。

decisions.choice: abominations: something people recoil from
decisions.reason: The word (to'evah) is what is detestable or repulsive. His friends now turn away from him in horror.

decisions.choice: shut in: confined like a prisoner or one set apart
decisions.reason: He may be shut up by sickness, as someone with a skin disease had to live apart (Leviticus 13:46), or he speaks of being trapped as in a prison. The picture is of complete isolation.

decisions.choice: like a prisoner
decisions.reason: Readable makes the picture of being shut in a comparison (m2).

decisions.choice: to'evot "忌まわしいもの" (L), "忌み嫌う" (B), "見るのもいやがる" (R); kalu' "閉じ込められ"
decisions.reason: Abominations is something people recoil from (m1); shut in, confined like a prisoner or one set apart (m2, uncertain).

source.text: עֵינִ֥י דָאֲבָ֗ה מִנִּ֫י עֹ֥נִי קְרָאתִ֣יךָ יְהוָ֣ה בְּכָל־י֑וֹם שִׁטַּ֖חְתִּי אֵלֶ֣יךָ כַפָּֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: My eye has grown faint from affliction; I have called you, YHWH, every day; I have spread out to you my palms.

en.L: My eye has grown faint from affliction; \q I have called [to] {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, every day; \q I have spread out my palms to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.B: My eyes are worn out with misery. \q Day after day I call on {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, \q holding out my hands to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.R: I have cried so much that I can hardly see. \q {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, I call to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} every day. \q I lift my hands to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} in prayer.

fr.L: Mon œil s’est épuisé à cause de l’affliction ; \q je {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}ai appelé, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, chaque jour ; \q j’ai étendu vers {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} mes paumes.
fr.B: Mes yeux sont usés par la misère. \q Jour après jour je {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}appelle, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q en tendant les mains vers {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.
fr.R: J’ai tant pleuré que je n’y vois presque plus. \q {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, je {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}appelle chaque jour. \q Je lève les mains vers {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} pour prier.

sw.L: Jicho langu limefifia kwa mateso; \q nimekuita, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kila siku; \q nimekunyooshea viganja vyangu.
sw.B: Macho yangu yamechoka kwa huzuni. \q Siku baada ya siku ninakuita, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q nikikunyooshea mikono yangu.
sw.R: Nimelia sana hata siwezi kuona vizuri. \q Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ninakuita kila siku. \q Ninakuinulia mikono yangu katika maombi.

es.L: Mi ojo se ha debilitado por la aflicción; \q {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} he invocado, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, cada día; \q he extendido hacia {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} mis palmas.
es.B: Mis ojos están gastados de tanta miseria. \q Día tras día {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} invoco, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q y extiendo mis manos hacia {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.
es.R: He llorado tanto que casi no puedo ver. \q {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} llamo todos los días. \q Levanto mis manos hacia {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} para orar.

vi.L: Mắt tôi đã mờ đi vì khốn khổ; \q tôi đã kêu cầu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, mỗi ngày; \q tôi đã giơ hai bàn tay tôi hướng về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Mắt tôi hao mòn vì đau khổ. \q Ngày này qua ngày khác tôi kêu cầu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, \q giơ tay hướng về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Tôi đã khóc nhiều đến nỗi mắt gần như không còn thấy rõ. \q Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, tôi kêu cầu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mỗi ngày. \q Tôi giơ tay lên cầu nguyện với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 제 눈이 고통으로 흐려졌습니다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 제가 날마다 주님을 불렀고, \q 주님께 제 손바닥을 펼쳤습니다.
ko.B: 제 눈이 괴로움으로 지쳐 버렸습니다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 날마다 주님을 부르며 \q 주님께 두 손을 내밉니다.
ko.R: 너무 울어서 앞이 잘 보이지 않습니다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 저는 날마다 주님께 부르짖습니다. \q 주님께 두 손을 들고 기도합니다.

pt.L: Os meus olhos se consumiram de aflição; \q clamei a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, todos os dias; \q estendi para {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} as palmas das minhas mãos.
pt.B: Os meus olhos estão gastos de tanta miséria. \q Dia após dia eu clamo a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, \q com as mãos estendidas para {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.
pt.R: Chorei tanto que quase não consigo enxergar. \q {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, eu clamo a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} todos os dias. \q Levanto as mãos para {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} em oração.

am.L: ዓይኔ ከመከራ የተነሣ ደከመች፤ \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ዕለት ዕለት ወደ አንተ ጠራሁ፤ \q መዳፎቼን ወደ አንተ ዘረጋሁ።
am.B: ዓይኖቼ በመከራ ደክመዋል። \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ቀን በቀን ወደ አንተ እጣራለሁ፤ \q እጆቼንም ወደ አንተ እዘረጋለሁ።
am.R: ከማልቀሴ ብዛት የተነሣ ማየት ተሳነኝ። \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ በየቀኑ ወደ አንተ እጮኻለሁ። \q በጸሎት እጆቼን ወደ አንተ አነሣለሁ።

hi.L: दुख के मारे मेरी आँख धुँधला गई है; \q हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, मैंने हर दिन तुझे पुकारा है; \q मैंने अपनी हथेलियाँ तेरी ओर फैलाई हैं।
hi.B: दुख से मेरी आँखें थक गई हैं। \q हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, मैं दिन-प्रतिदिन तुझे पुकारता हूँ, \q और अपने हाथ तेरी ओर फैलाता हूँ।
hi.R: मैं इतना रोया हूँ कि मुझे ठीक से दिखाई नहीं देता। \q हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, मैं हर दिन तुझे पुकारता हूँ। \q मैं प्रार्थना में अपने हाथ तेरी ओर उठाता हूँ।

ru.L: Глаз мой истомился от страдания; \q я взывал к {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, каждый день; \q я простирал к {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}} мои ладони.
ru.B: Мои глаза измучены горем. \q День за днём я призываю {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}}, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, \q протягивая к {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}} руки.
ru.R: Я так много плакал, что почти ничего не вижу. \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, я зову {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}} каждый день. \q Я поднимаю к {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}} руки в молитве.

ja.L: わたしの目は、苦しみのために衰えた。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、わたしは毎日あなたを呼び、 \q あなたに向かって、わたしの手のひらを広げた。
ja.B: わたしの目は、悲しみのために弱り果てた。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、わたしは来る日も来る日もあなたを呼び求め、 \q あなたに向かって両手を差し伸べている。
ja.R: わたしは泣いてばかりいて、目もよく見えないほどだ。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、わたしは毎日あなたを呼んでいる。 \q 祈りながら、あなたに向かって両手を上げている。

decisions.choice: my eye has grown faint: worn out by grief
decisions.reason: Weeping and suffering dim the eyes (6:8; 31:10).

decisions.choice: questions that expect the answer no
decisions.reason: Verses 11-13 are questions with an obvious answer: no. If the psalmist dies, God loses one who praises him (6:6; 30:10). The argument is a plea to act now.

decisions.choice: shades: the dead as weak shadows
decisions.reason: The word (repha'im) names the dead in Sheol as faint and powerless (Isaiah 14:9; 26:14).

decisions.choice: the psalm speaks from inside the darkness
decisions.reason: Here the dead do not rise to praise. Other Scripture holds out hope of rising from the dead (Isaiah 26:19; Daniel 12:2), but this psalm gives its questions no answer, and the translation leaves them as they are.

decisions.choice: Selah: a word whose meaning is no longer known
alternatives: lift up (the voice or the music)
decisions.reason: Selah stands at the end of a line 71 times in the Psalms and 3 times in Habakkuk 3. It is probably a direction for singing or music, perhaps a pause or an interlude; the ancient Greek translation renders it with a word meaning "interlude". It is not part of what is said, and here it marks a break after the line.

decisions.choice: Selah, kept as it is
decisions.reason: Its meaning is unknown (see the meaning decision on Selah), so every level keeps the word rather than guess, and keeps it apart from the sentence.

decisions.choice: "les ombres" for the rephaʾim at Literal; "les esprits des morts" (Balanced) and "les morts" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision describes the dead as weak shadows; French "ombres" keeps that picture at Literal, as the English "shades" does.

decisions.choice: "vivuli vya wafu" (shadows of the dead) at Literal for the rephaim; "roho za wafu" at Balanced
decisions.reason: The Hebrew pictures the dead as weak shadows. "Mizimu" would bring in the spirits of ancestors that Swahili tradition honours, which is not the picture here.

decisions.choice: "vong linh" (L), "linh hồn người chết" (B), "người chết" (R) for the shades
decisions.reason: The word pictures the dead as weak shadows (see the meaning decision). "bóng ma" means a ghost that haunts; "vong linh" is the spirit of one who has died, and the other levels say it more plainly.

decisions.choice: refa'im "死者の霊たち" (L), "死者の霊" (B), "死んだ人たち" (R); yodukha "感謝する" (hodah, every level)
decisions.reason: Questions that expect the answer no (m1); the shades are the dead as weak shadows (m2). hodah 感謝する as PSA-1.

decisions.choice: Abaddon: the place of destruction, a name for the realm of the dead
decisions.reason: The word means "destruction" and stands beside Sheol and death (Job 26:6; 28:22; Proverbs 15:11). In Revelation 9:11 it is the name of the angel of the abyss.

decisions.choice: loyal love
decisions.reason: As in 86:5 (chesed).

decisions.choice: the place of destruction
decisions.reason: Readable says what the name means (m1).

decisions.choice: "A-ba-đôn" (L, B); "nơi hủy diệt" (R)
decisions.reason: Abaddon is another name for the realm of the dead, meaning destruction (see the meaning decision). Literal and Balanced keep the name, as Revelation 9:11 does; Readable gives its meaning, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "신실하심" for God's faithfulness; "아바돈" (L, B), "멸망의 곳" (R)
decisions.reason: "신실하심" is the terms note's word for emunah, with the honorific noun form used of God. Abaddon is a name for the realm of the dead meaning destruction (meaning decision m1); Literal and Balanced keep the name and Readable says what it means, as the English does.

decisions.choice: o Abadom (L, B); o lugar da destruição (R)
decisions.reason: As Job 26:6 sets it in Portuguese: the name spelled "Abadom", the form Revelation 9:11 uses (m1), with the article as a place name; Readable says what it means, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: Abaddon as the name "አባዶን" (Literal, Balanced), as Revelation 9:11 in the Amharic New Testament; Readable "የጥፋት ስፍራ"
decisions.reason: The name for the realm of the dead keeps its New Testament form; Readable gives its sense, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: अबद्दोन
decisions.reason: Abaddon is a name for the realm of the dead, "destruction" (m1); Literal and Balanced keep the name in the form of Revelation 9:11 in this translation, and Readable says what it means, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "Аваддон" (L, B); "место погибели" (R)
decisions.reason: Abaddon is a name for the realm of the dead meaning "destruction" (the meaning decision); Literal and Balanced keep the name, in the form Revelation 9:11 gives it in this translation, and Readable says what it means.

decisions.choice: 'Avaddon "アバドン" (L, B), "滅びの場所" (R); chasdekha "あなたの誠実" (L), "変わらぬいつくしみ" (B, R); 'emunatekha "あなたの真実"
decisions.reason: Abaddon is the place of destruction, a name for the realm of the dead (m1), as PSA-1; chesed and 'emunah in the Psalter's forms (m2).

records.literal_gloss: Will your wonder be known in the darkness, and your righteousness in [the] land of forgetting?
